// Negative control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1443): the same aliased images, each carrying the prop. The scan must pass it.
import { Image as Pic } from 'react-native';
import FastImage from 'react-native-fast-image';
const Snap = Pic;
export function Good({ uri }: { uri: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Pic source={{ uri }} accessibilityIgnoresInvertColors />
      <FastImage source={{ uri }} accessibilityIgnoresInvertColors={true} />
      <Snap source={{ uri }} accessibilityIgnoresInvertColors />
    </>
  );
}
